verdict.rationale: An official CLI is a fair axis for a robotics fleet platform, but the evidence pack never documents one. It only shows a Docker-based agent installer, the Python Cloud SDK, the Agent SDK, the Admin API with a per-endpoint Try It console, and the JavaScript toolkit. These are developer building blocks and other features, not an official command-line tool, so they earn no credit here.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can use an official CLI
